population: All 20 VAS minute cells finite numeric within 0-10; unique ID required; no E/T imputation
shared_controller: User confirms TTL logs are present in all records; native TTL levels/codes retained without invented semantic labels

synchronization.model: fnirs_seconds = acq_seconds + offset; slope fixed 1; report drift diagnostic
synchronization.acceptance: Unique offset with sufficient order-preserving TTL matches; minute labels remain recording-relative
synchronization.source_scope: Only current accepted subject-file mapping; duplicate/export identity audited separately

ecg.hrv_acceptance: Algorithm-screened recording-relative HRV; no interpolation or gap bridging
ecg.channel_policy: Process all raw independent ECG channels
ecg.scope: ECG only; EGG requires separate spectral/QC interpretation

association.outcome: Mean observed VAS in corresponding 5-minute interval, 0-10
association.estimand: Exploratory within-subject concurrent association; not causal
association.model: Subject fixed effects and categorical recording-relative window time; subject bootstrap
association.readiness: Requires unique record identity, TTL/record-start mapping, valid window and QC
